node: Nuclear fuel cycle, HALEU, reactor components, licensing, and EPC execution
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the regulated nuclear fuel and reactor supply-chain node, with emphasis on scarce HALEU enrichment, TRISO/advanced-fuel fabrication, qualified nuclear components, and EPC-adjacent execution rather than utilities alone. The strongest chokepoint exposure appears in Centrus Energy for HALEU enrichment and BWX Technologies for qualified nuclear components, advanced fuel, and reactor manufacturing. X-energy adds a public-market pure-play around advanced reactors plus TRISO-X fuel fabrication licensing, while ASP Isotopes is a speculative shadow candidate tied to future isotope/enrichment capacity but still requiring major regulatory and technical validation.
